title: Product Manager – AI Security
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026 or February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 We're hiring
 **two technical Product Managers** 
 to own core areas of this new AI security platform.
   

  

 You'll join one of two workstreams:
   

  

* Cloud Discovery: Build a continuously updated inventory of the AI agents, models, and AI\-enabled applications running across customers' cloud environments, including the data and permissions they can access. This role requires strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security.
* AI Security Platform: Own a core area of the platform across gateway, agentic security, forensics, or shared platform capabilities, working closely with engineering, security research, design, and enterprise customers.


 Both roles require a PM who has
 **shipped B2B security or infrastructure products** 
 , is technically comfortable working with engineering teams, and uses AI tools as part of their daily product workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization for your product area from discovery through launch.
* Lead customer discovery with CISOs, security architects, and cloud/AI platform teams, translating customer needs into clear problem statements and PRDs.
* Partner with engineering and security research on scope, technical trade\-offs, and delivery, and participate in technical design reviews.
* Define success metrics and ensure the product measures adoption, coverage, and detection effectiveness.
* Work with product marketing, sales engineering, and support on positioning, enablement, and launches.
* Track the evolving AI security landscape, including agent frameworks, LLM providers, regulation, and competitors, and translate relevant developments into product strategy.
* Use AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and day\-to\-day product work.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, including 2\+ years working on security, cloud infrastructure, or developer\-facing products.
* Proven track record of shipping products used by enterprise security or infrastructure teams, with measurable outcomes.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable reading API specifications, discussing distributed\-systems trade\-offs, and understanding how LLM applications and AI agents are deployed.
* Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear PRDs, decision documents, and executive updates.
* Practical, daily use of AI tools and LLM/agentic workflows in your own product work.
* Fluent English and comfortable collaborating with distributed teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-moving environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Product experience in cybersecurity, including DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, CSPM/CNAPP, or AI security.
* Strong practical knowledge of a major cloud provider, including services, IAM, and inventory/audit APIs.
* Engineering background or hands\-on scripting experience, particularly Python.
* Experience working with AI compliance and regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic workflows into product teams.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your own product work, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed your workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and decision\-making** 
 , not simply as a writing or autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Shape a new product line at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work directly with engineering, security research, and enterprise customers on emerging security challenges.
* Own a significant product area with high visibility and influence.
* Help define how enterprises discover, understand, and secure AI systems.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Consulting Manager role in a global financial services practice responsible for delivering payment transformation and messaging optimization programs using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards. The role focuses on advisory solution design and implementation oversight in a hybrid work model during day shifts ensuring secure efficient and compliant cross border payment operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex consulting engagements for financial institutions focused on modernizing cross border payment flows using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards to achieve measurable gains in efficiency and compliance.
* Oversee end to end assessment of current payment messaging landscapes including processing workflows and system interfaces to identify gaps against evolving industry regulations and scheme requirements.
* Provide detailed advisory on migration strategies from existing SWIFT MT based processes toward ISO XML 20022 formats ensuring continuity of business operations and minimal disruption to clients.
* Drive design of target state payment messaging architectures that integrate SWIFT services core banking systems and downstream applications to support scalable and resilient transaction processing.
* Coordinate with product owners architects and operations teams to define functional and nonfunctional requirements for new or enhanced payment and messaging solutions aligned to client priorities.
* Develop clear and structured documentation including business process maps data models and message specifications for SWIFT MT and ISO XML 20022 to support implementation and testing activities.
* Guide testing strategies for payment messaging transformations including creation of test scenarios validation of message mapping and resolution of defects impacting transaction quality or timeliness.
* Analyze operational and financial metrics related to payment volumes straight through processing rates and exception handling to recommend targeted process improvements.
* Collaborate with risk and compliance stakeholders to ensure that SWIFT payment and messaging solutions adhere to regulatory expectations information security standards and industry best practices.
* Present concise and insightful findings to client management teams highlighting business impacts associated with messaging changes and providing clear recommendations for phased implementation.
* Support internal capability development by sharing knowledge on SWIFT MT standards ISO XML 20022 message structures and leading practices in payment transformation across consulting teams.
* Contribute to proposal creation and opportunity shaping by translating client needs in payment and messaging domains into well structured engagement plans and value propositions.
* Engage in continuous improvement of delivery methods by refining templates accelerators and reusable assets that reduce time to value for payment messaging consulting projects.


**Qualifications**
* Possess a strong foundation in SWIFT MT messages including understanding of core financial message types their fields and associated processing flows across correspondent banking networks.
* Demonstrate practical experience with ISO XML 20022 messages covering payment initiation clearing settlement and reporting structures as applied to real world implementations for financial institutions.
* Apply working knowledge of SWIFT payment and messages platforms including connectivity options and interface mechanisms to advise on optimal integration approaches with client systems.
* Bring proven consulting experience within financial services or payments domains spanning at least nine years with responsibility for delivering complex client projects and achieving defined outcomes.
* Show capacity to communicate technical messaging concepts in clear business oriented language enabling client stakeholders to make informed decisions about payment transformation journeys.
* Exhibit familiarity with hybrid work models and demonstrate ability to coordinate onsite and remote collaboration effectively during day shifts to maintain project momentum.
* Display strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to interpret payment data transaction flows and exception patterns to recommend practical remediation steps.
* Value inclusive and collaborative ways of working that encourage diverse perspectives and foster transparent interactions with client and internal teams throughout engagement lifecycles.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**Company Description** 
 Shootwords Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a social media company focused on voice\-first interaction and future\-ready communication. The platform enables users to post and discuss their favorite topics using voice comments, promoting more authentic and engaging conversations. By prioritizing audio content over traditional text\-based posts, Shootwords aims to redefine how communities share opinions and ideas online. The company is building a dynamic, user\-centric ecosystem for meaningful dialogue and creator\-led growth. Prospective team members will join an early\-stage venture with significant opportunity to influence product direction and market impact.
 



 Good news is we have lately secured a good long\-term business deal for Shootwords. Though currently we are pivoting to new landmarks and roadmaps. Our long term vision is to make this social media space a better place for generations to come, leveraging voice and A.I.
 



**Role Description** 
 As a Co\-Founder with Investment at Shootwords Technologies Pvt. Ltd., you will play a central role in shaping the company’s strategy, product vision, and growth roadmap in a remote, collaborative environment. You will drive day\-to\-day activities such as defining market positioning, validating product features with users, and analyzing platform performance to inform decisions. You will lead efforts in building partnerships, supporting sales initiatives, and developing marketing campaigns to increase user acquisition and engagement. The role also involves coordinating with technical and creative contributors, managing priorities, and ensuring that operational processes support sustainable growth. This is a full\-time, remote leadership role that requires hands\-on involvement in both strategic planning and execution.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong analytical skills and research capabilities to evaluate market trends, user behavior, and product performance.
* Excellent communication skills for internal collaboration, stakeholder management, and external representation of the brand.
* Sales and marketing skills to drive user acquisition, retention, and revenue growth through targeted campaigns and partnerships.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, with experience or strong interest in early\-stage startups, social media, or consumer technology.
* Ability to work remotely with high ownership, adaptability, and self\-management in a fast\-paced environment.
* Background in business, technology, or related fields is beneficial; prior leadership or co\-founding experience is an advantage.
* Good CIBIL score is a must.
* Good to have experience in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

title: Associate Principal Product Manager - Networks
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The team**
 As part of the Product Management organization, we develop the platform that drives the next generation of enterprise intelligence and process improvement. We are a team of product enthusiasts who like to push the boundaries of the status quo and drive the product forward with innovative thinking.
   

  

 The Data Foundation \& Networks team is dedicated to revolutionizing how businesses connect and collaborate. Our mission is to create a seamless, efficient ecosystem that streamlines processes for our clients. Because data integration is the bedrock of our platform, our team focuses on building the pipelines that allow different enterprise ecosystems to securely ingest, manage, and share critical data at scale.
   

  

**The role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Associate Principal Product Manager** 
 to lead our Networks initiative. This exciting solution aims to transform how businesses interact with their partners, suppliers, and customers by enabling them to share data securely and efficiently.
   

  

 You will be responsible for defining the platform vision and strategy for our Networks product. To succeed, you need a deep technical DNA combined with expertise in data sharing and business networks. You will transform technical complexity into seamless plug\-and\-play data\-sharing experiences for the world’s largest enterprises leveraging Celonis Intelligence.
   

  

**The work you'll do**
* Define the vision, build, and execute the roadmap for our Networks product aligned with broader business goals.
* Partner closely with engineering to optimize ingestion capabilities so network participants can share massive enterprise datasets smoothly.
* Work directly with customers, engineering teams, and the go\-to\-market organization to deeply understand the data\-sharing needs of network participants.
* Leverage your domain expertise in modern ETL/ELT landscapes to identify key product features, integration points, and collaborative use cases.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for Networks, championing its data\-sharing features, security protocols, and value proposition both internally and externally.
* Establish partnerships with key players in the network ecosystem to foster innovation, navigate complex third\-party data architectures, and drive platform adoption.
* Monitor key product metrics and performance indicators, evaluating feature adoption and data throughput to inform decision\-making and continuous improvement.


**The Qualifications You Need**
* 6\+ years in product management, with at least 3 years focused on enterprise software solutions.
* Strong understanding of data ingestion patterns and protocols.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and understanding complex business processes and challenges.
* Ability to hold your own in architectural discussions with Engineering while simplifying those concepts for C\-level executives.
* Proven track record of crafting vision and strategy for complex enterprise software products and successfully launching them to market.
* Strong analytical skills with a love for using data to optimize system performance and drive actionable product decisions.
* Exceptional ability to influence without authority and tell a compelling story about the why behind the what.


**Nice to have**
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business to connect technical network performance to broad enterprise ROI.
* Familiarity or experience with modern data management tools like Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Direct experience with supply chain platforms, major cloud ecosystems, and navigating complex ERP architectures.


**What Celonis can offer you:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70\-20\-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well\-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion \& Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value\-Driven Impact: Join a mission\-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.


**About Us:**
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry\-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
   

  

 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
